title: Levain-Inspired Two-Chip Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪  Yield: Approximate...
description: Levain-Inspired Two-Chip Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪  Yield: Approximately 8-10 large cookies Ingredients: - 2 1/4 cups (313g) all-purpose flour - 1 ½ teaspoons baking powder - 1 teaspoon baking soda - 1 teaspoon cornstarch - 3/4 cup (150g) dark brown sugar - 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar - 2 cold eggs - 1 tablespoons vanilla bean paste  - 1 cup (225g) unsalted butter, slightly softened - Pinch of salt - 1 1/4 cup (215g) semi-sweet chocolate chips - 3/4 cup (180 g) dark chocolate chips Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and cornstarch in a medium bowl. Set aside. 3. Cream together brown sugar, granulated sugar, and butter in a large bowl until light and fluffy. 4. Beat in eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla extract, for 3-4 minutes until the batter turns pale and the sugar is well incorporated. 5. Gradually mix in dry ingredients until just combined, being careful not to overmix. 6. Stir in chocolate chips. 7. Scoop 2 tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet. Leave the dough balls slightly rough and stacked, with a rustic texture. Place 4 cookies on each pan, leaving 4 inches of space between each one. Top with extra chocolate chips. 8. Bake for 13-16 minutes on middle rack or until edges are lightly golden brown. 9. Remove from oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. #chocolatechipcookies #thickcookies #chocolatechip #cookie #Recipe #baking
